title: Follow the installed OS-specific procedure
when: User agrees that dedicated machine coverage is needed
need: Use the installed Pack version: dedicated account/network, named test-machine settings, workstation-local SSH/desktop secrets, required tools/sign-ins and effective desktop permissions. Supported recipes cover macOS, Ubuntu 24.04 and Windows through WSL2; native Windows Yoke is not this fixture.
surface: Pack README → host-provisioning → per-OS procedure; settings contract.
gap: Setup support exists; improve discovery instead of building another provisioner. Keep project-specific infrastructure/accounts and private fixture policy out of a universal user recipe.
